title: Heroku OAuth access token (HRKU-prefixed): one-property twin (length)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 64 characters vs the provider-documented 65 (devcenter.heroku.com: "65 characters long and prefixed with HRKU-"). Twin of "Heroku OAuth access token (HRKU-prefixed): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
